title: Automate Invoicing & Payment Reminders in Zoho Books #Shorts
description:
Struggling with late client payments? Learn how MSMEs use Zoho Books to automate recurring invoices, turn on automated payment reminders, and connect payment gateways for faster cash flow.

1. Go to Sales › Recurring Invoices and define standard service billing schedules
2. Navigate to Settings › Reminders to enable automated payment reminders before due dates
3. Integrate local payment gateways under Settings › Online Payments for instant customer payouts

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

angle.problem: MSMEs claiming digital software credits struggle to automate invoice creation and payment reminders.
angle.solution: Set up automated recurring invoices and payment reminder workflows in Zoho Books.
steps: Go to Sales > Recurring Invoices and define standard service billing schedules
Navigate to Settings > Reminders to enable automated payment reminders before due dates
Integrate local payment gateways under Settings > Online Payments for instant customer payouts
angle.result: Accelerates cash flow and eliminates manual invoice chasing for growing MSMEs
angle.wow: Automated payment reminders increase on-time customer payments by up to 40% without extra labor.
angle.hook: SMEDAN teamed up with Zoho for MSME credits - automate your invoicing now!
